name: Clean SaaS Minimal
description: High-clarity layout with generous whitespace and clear conversion hierarchy
implementation: Use 12-column grid, max content width 1200px, one dominant CTA style, subtle shadow scale 2
use_cases: SaaS websites, product marketing pages, onboarding surfaces
do_examples: Single strong hero message with one primary CTA repeated after proof
dont_examples: Three hero headlines and multiple equal primary buttons

name: Data-Dense Console
description: Functional interface prioritizing scan speed and control clarity
implementation: Use compact spacing scale, tabular typography for numbers, deterministic component states
use_cases: Developer tools, admin dashboards, analytics products
do_examples: Sticky filters + keyboard shortcuts + clear empty states
dont_examples: Decorative gradients reducing chart and table readability

name: Conversion Commerce
description: Visual merchandising with fast purchase paths and trust reinforcement
implementation: Use product card system, sticky add-to-cart zone, concise trust badges near action
use_cases: Ecommerce PDPs, category pages, seasonal campaigns
do_examples: Primary buy action near price and shipping promise
dont_examples: Hidden shipping cost until checkout completion

name: Premium Editorial
description: Story-led visual rhythm with strong typographic hierarchy
implementation: Use serif headlines, image-led section breaks, restrained animation speed
use_cases: Luxury launches, real estate showcases, editorial brand pages
do_examples: Hero narrative followed by curated proof blocks
dont_examples: Aggressive promotional banners in premium narrative flow

name: Authority Professional
description: Credibility-first composition with evidence-driven messaging
implementation: Use neutral palette, explicit proof components, process timeline blocks
use_cases: Legal, consulting, financial advisory, B2B services
do_examples: Case outcome metrics and transparent engagement process
dont_examples: Generic claims without source or supporting evidence

name: Community Warm
description: People-first design that highlights belonging and ongoing activity
implementation: Use member avatars, event modules, contribution prompts, warm accent usage
use_cases: Community platforms, creator spaces, nonprofit hubs
do_examples: Member stories and upcoming events above join CTA
dont_examples: Join CTA without showing any active member signals

name: Health Clarity
description: Reassuring interaction patterns with stress-reducing visual rhythm
implementation: Use high contrast text, clear labels, plain-language microcopy, larger touch targets
use_cases: Healthcare portals, appointment booking, patient onboarding
do_examples: Simple stepper with clear progress and support contact
dont_examples: Medical jargon-heavy onboarding with small low-contrast labels

name: Launch Hype
description: High-energy campaign style for waitlists and event drops
implementation: Use countdown module, phased reveal sections, strong contrast action bars
use_cases: Product launches, events, ticket drops, beta waitlists
do_examples: Countdown paired with tangible value and launch timeline
dont_examples: Fake urgency timer that resets and breaks trust

name: Marketplace Dual-Flow
description: Balanced two-audience layout with mirrored value propositions
implementation: Use audience toggle, split proof modules, unified trust layer before CTA
use_cases: Buyer-seller marketplaces, talent platforms, booking exchanges
do_examples: Separate buyer and seller pathways with dedicated CTAs
dont_examples: Single mixed message block that confuses both audiences

name: Education Structured
description: Outcome-driven educational funnel with progressive disclosure
implementation: Use curriculum sections, learning outcomes, instructor proof, FAQ objections
use_cases: Courses, bootcamps, coaching programs
do_examples: Outcome summary before curriculum deep dive
dont_examples: Listing modules only without expected outcomes or support model

name: Trust Infrastructure - Cybersecurity Platform
description: Distinct visual system for Cybersecurity Platform with clear hierarchy, proof rhythm, and focused conversion flow.
implementation: Define section rhythm as promise -> evidence -> action with one dominant CTA per viewport.
use_cases: Cybersecurity Platform landing pages, lifecycle pages, and campaign-specific funnels
do_examples: Place strongest social proof immediately before primary conversion step.
dont_examples: Do not repeat the same abstract value claim across multiple sections.

name: Human-Centered Service - HR Tech Suite
description: Distinct visual system for HR Tech Suite with clear hierarchy, proof rhythm, and focused conversion flow.
implementation: Use progressive disclosure for complex details and keep critical trust info visible near actions.
use_cases: HR Tech Suite landing pages, lifecycle pages, and campaign-specific funnels
do_examples: Use intent-specific CTA copy tied to user outcome.
dont_examples: Do not hide pricing, eligibility, or policy constraints until late stages.
